items.title: Solana is about to halve its block times as final 200-millisecond upgrade nears
items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.description: The network is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.
items.content: The network is completing a seven-week push to produce blocks twice as frequently, though validators face higher costs and tighter operating windows.

items.title: XRP Ledger adds new controls for banks, stablecoins and tokenized funds
items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.description: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.
items.content: The feature lets businesses give separate accounts limited powers such as approving customers or making payments, while keeping the keys that control their main holdings offline.

items.title: Ether bets were wiped out at six times bitcoin’s rate in crypto’s $1 billion flush
items.author: Shaurya Malwa
items.description: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than bitcoin despite ether’s market value being less than a fifth as large.
items.content: About $356 million in ETH positions were liquidated over 24 hours, more than bitcoin despite ether’s market value being less than a fifth as large.

items.title: Bitcoin rebounds to $82,000 as Trump rules out Iran strikes, oil drops
items.author: Omkar Godbole
items.description: Bitcoin rebounded to $82,000 as Trump ruled out an Iran strike before the midterms, while crypto security experts pushed back on “bunker mode” fears.

items.description: As Democrats steadily rise in their potential to take back a Senate majority, Senator Richard Blumenthal is digging into Tether's U.S. financial partnership.

items.title: Crypto crumbles as anniversary of flash crash nears
items.author: Stephen Alpher
items.description: It was October 10, 2025, when bitcoin plunged from about $122,000 to $105,000, with much of the decline occurring within minutes.

items.description: In opposition to federal oversight of the prediction markets, the National Football League has sided with states, Gary Gensler and one of the authors of the relevant law.

items.description: Arkham data shows the 12,267 BTC went to unlabeled wallets rather than an exchange, a day after $383 million hit Coinbase Prime.

items.title: EU securities regulator gives crypto platforms 3 months to remove unauthorized stablecoins
items.author: Olivier Acuna
items.description: ESMA said authorized platforms must block new access to stablecoins that fail to meet MiCA rules, while national authorities oversee existing customer holdings.
